edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against admin inside the onlyAdmin modifier to gate privileged functions.
msg.sender is compared against admin in the pausable modifier, letting the admin bypass pause flags.
Constructor argument _admin is written into the admin state variable that controls all privileged access.
Constructor argument flags initializes the paused bitmask state variable.
adminPause overwrites the paused state variable with caller-supplied flags (admin-gated).
key parameter flows into the assembly sstore slot operand.
value parameter flows into the assembly sstore value operand.
key parameter selects the storage slot for the masked write.
value parameter is xored with the old value in the masked storage write.
mask parameter decides which bits of the storage slot are modified.
Local oldval (from sload) is combined with value and mask in the masked sstore expression.
destination parameter becomes the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
amount parameter becomes the value of the external ETH transfer.
Admin-supplied target address receives an arbitrary delegatecall.
Caller-supplied data bytes are forwarded as calldata to the delegatecall target.
_bridge constructor argument is stored into the bridge state variable.
_admin is forwarded to the base constructor which sets the privileged admin address.
_pausedFlags is forwarded to the base constructor which sets the paused bitmask.
delegatecall success flag is captured by the success local variable.
delegatecall return data is captured by the rdata local variable and returned to the caller.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of adminPause.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of adminSstore.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of adminSstoreWithMask.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of adminSendEth.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of adminReceiveEth.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of adminDelegatecall.
NearProver constructor invokes the AdminControlled base constructor, inheriting its privileged setup.
adminSendEth performs an external ETH transfer that executes the destination's fallback/receive code, enabling reentrant calls.
adminDelegatecall executes arbitrary external target code, creating a callback path into the contract.
